questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: It's right across the bay, you won't be far from what you're used to. Campus is great and if you don't mind less options of what to see, where to go, eating out - you'll be just fine. Living in a big house on a historical campus was a great experience for me and I'm sure it will be for you too!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I'm not sure how much humor I'm allowed in this report, but the local Burger King doesn't stock ketchup and that boggles my mind.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Getting to live essentially inside a botanical garden and watching all the seasons rotate through it. Beauty in each one!

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Probably my Masters' thesis; Took a lot of time and energy from me.
